responsibility: This file orchestrates initialization of the GNU Modula-2 frontend and its runtime-support modules. It owns the ordered startup sequence for one-time frontend setup and per-compilation setup, invoking the generated Modula-2 runtime/compiler module initializers and then dispatching to M2Comp_compile for a source file, so it is the bridge between GCC driver entry into gm2 and the internal Modula-2 compilation subsystem state.
same_name_distinction: Implements the startup sequence itself: it calls the generated _M2_* runtime/frontend initializers in two ordered phases and then invokes M2Comp_compile. Unlike init.h and init.def, this is the executable bridge code rather than just interface declarations.
